linked_context.page_description: Einstein lost the argument about a probabilistic universe. Software has just lost the same one. What that costs, what scale buys back, and where the road forks.
linked_context.page_excerpt:
Einstein lost the argument about a probabilistic universe. Software has just lost the same one. What that costs, what scale buys back, and where the road forks.

On 4 December 1926, Albert Einstein wrote to his friend Max Born and lost his temper in the most polite way available to him. The new physics was impressive, he admitted. It produced results. But something inside it was wrong, and he could not let it go. "Jedenfalls bin ich überzeugt, dass der Alte nicht würfelt." In any case, I am convinced that the Old One does not play dice.

What offended him is easy enough to say at a dinner table. The new theory claimed that at the smallest scale, nature does not decide in advance. You cannot predict what a particle will do, only the odds of what it might do. Einstein was certain this meant the theory was unfinished, and that somewhere underneath there had to be real machinery making real decisions.

hacker_news.summary: Learnings from leading and building teams at Stripe

linked_context.page_title: Space to cook: notes on engineering leadership
linked_context.page_description: Learnings from leading and building teams at Stripe
linked_context.page_excerpt:
Some things I've learned about leadership and management while building and growing software teams. Adapted, in part, from an internal document I wrote in early 2026 while at Stripe and written as a reminder for myself and for anyone interested in software engineering management.

Note: I’ve omitted many of the obvious management tropes like, “invest in your best people”, etc, since these can be read in countless management books and blogs.

I quite liked this because it is simple, easy to remember, and gets the point across: we're here to serve our users first and ourselves last, and just about every decision we make as teams or individuals can be guided by or checked against that hierarchy: Am I optimizing for my team at the expense of our users? Rethink it. Am I putting myself before my team? Rethink it.

Einstein lost the argument about a probabilistic universe. Software has just lost the same one. What that costs, what scale buys back, and where the road forks.

On 4 December 1926, Albert Einstein wrote to his friend Max Born and lost his temper in the most polite way available to him. The new physics was impressive, he admitted. It produced results. But something inside it was wrong, and he could not let it go. "Jedenfalls bin ich überzeugt, dass der Alte nicht würfelt." In any case, I am convinced that the Old One does not play dice.

What offended him is easy enough to say at a dinner table. The new theory claimed that at the smallest scale, nature does not decide in advance. You cannot predict what a particle will do, only the odds of what it might do. Einstein was certain this meant the theory was unfinished, and that somewhere underneath there had to be real machinery making real decisions.

source_briefs.item_name: God Does Not Play Dice. We Built Software That Does
source_briefs.content_summary: 一篇博客文章，将爱因斯坦关于“上帝不掷骰子”的著名争论类比到现代软件领域。文章指出，如同爱因斯坦在量子力学中反对概率性宇宙观一样，传统确定性软件范式也正在被概率性系统（如基于大模型的AI）所挑战。文章探讨了这种转变的成本、规模效益以及未来的发展路径。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 文章提出了一个深刻的哲学和技术类比，揭示了AI时代软件本质从确定性向概率性范式的根本性转变及其深远影响。

source_briefs.item_name: Passive investing fueled a bull market – and could bring it down
source_briefs.content_summary: 文章讨论了被动投资（主要通过指数基金）的增长如何支撑了美股牛市，同时也可能为市场暴跌埋下隐患。被动投资资金大量流入401(k)等普通美国人的退休账户，推高了股市估值，但也可能导致市场在危机时缺乏流动性并加剧下跌。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 该分析指出了金融市场结构中的一个潜在系统性风险，即广泛采用的被动投资策略可能在市场转向时放大波动性。

source_briefs.content_summary: 多家媒体报道，特朗普称关于霍尔木兹海峡的协议可能在一两天内达成，目前伊朗与阿曼的谈判已进入最后阶段。相关报道指出，一项协议正在形成（但可能并非特朗普所期望的那种），并且由于伊朗和阿曼达成协议的消息，油价已连续三日下跌。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 霍尔木兹海峡是全球石油运输的关键咽喉要道，任何关于该地区的协议都将对地缘政治和全球能源市场产生重大影响。

source_briefs.item_name: New CDC director is confirmed, giving agency its first permanent leader in a year
source_briefs.content_summary: 美国参议院确认了埃里卡·施瓦茨博士为美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）的新任主任，这是该机构一年来首次拥有常任领导。相关报道涵盖了确认投票过程，以及关于她是否会违抗小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪（RFK Jr.）的辩论。
source_briefs.ai_comment: CDC领导层的稳定对于美国公共卫生政策的连续性和应对潜在健康危机的能力至关重要。

source_briefs.content_summary: 美联社等媒体报道，进步派政治人物阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德在密歇根州参议院民主党初选中获胜，从一个曾被遗忘的政治人物实现突破。报道描述了一个分裂的民主党正试图在剩余13周内团结在他身后，主流民主党人也搁置疑虑支持这位左翼政治圈外人。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 此事件反映了美国民主党内部进步派势力的持续崛起，以及初选后党内整合的挑战。
